punchline: People carrying pagers reported feeling better at work than in front of the television, yet they said they would rather be off work.
thirty_sec: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi gave people pagers that beeped at random times and asked what they were doing and how they felt. At work they were more often absorbed, yet they wished to be elsewhere. In passive free time, like television, they felt flatter. His reading: open time without a goal or feedback lets attention drift, so happiness is built from challenges.
